Boris Kravchenko is a Senior Platform Engineer at FinTrust Systems, a fintech company focused on financial infrastructure. As a peer, I’ve collaborated on several projects, and his contributions stand out for their consistency and depth.  

Boris’s expertise in AWS architecture is central to FinTrust’s operations. He designed scalable systems for real-time transaction processing, mentoring junior engineers on best practices. His work on cost optimization reduced cloud expenses by 18% without sacrificing performance, a balance few achieve. He also led Terraform deployments across GCP, streamlining infrastructure management and enabling cross-team collaboration. His ability to translate complex requirements into robust, automated solutions is rare.  

Beyond technical skills, Boris brings reliability and curiosity. He once debugged a critical production issue overnight, resolving it before morning meetings. His approach to Linux systems is methodical—whether maintaining servers or scripting automation, he prioritizes stability and clarity. While Python isn’t his primary tool, he uses it effectively for data analysis tasks, adding value where needed.  

Boris’s work ethic is unshakable. He thrives in high-pressure environments, consistently delivering under tight deadlines. His combination of technical rigor and collaborative spirit makes him a key asset to any team. I’d strongly recommend him for any role requiring both depth and adaptability.
